title: Tailscale
description: See which of your Tailscale devices are online, copy a device's Tailscale IP or name, and connect or disconnect Tailscale without opening its menu, from Hyper+Space, its own page or the menu bar.
examples: Type pi: your Raspberry Pi with its OS, IP and whether it is online; Return copies its 100.x IP
Glance at the menu bar: 🛜 3 says three devices are online; click it for the list and Disconnect, or Connect when Tailscale is off, opening Tailscale.app first when it isn't running
